title: getCRUCLdata
text: {getCRUCLdata} package provides functions automate importing CRU CL v. 2.0 climatology data R, facilitate calculation minimum temperature maximum temperature, formats data [data.table::data.table] object [terra:SpatRaster]. CRU CL v. 2.0 data gridded climatology 1961-1990 monthly means released 2002 cover land areas (excluding Antarctica) 10 arcminutes (0.1666667 arc degree) resolution. information see description data provided University East Anglia Climate Research Unit (CRU), https://crudata.uea.ac.uk/cru/data/hrg/tmc/readme.txt.

title: getCRUCLdata
text: package automatically converts elevation values kilometres metres. package crops spatial outputs extent ymin = -60, ymax = 85, xmin = -180, xmax = 180. Note original wind data include land area parts Antarctica, omitted. also elevation values around Dead Sea area corresponding climate values removed. left complete suite data climate elevation data grid cells provided, data original datasets.

title: getCRUCLdata
text: Logical arguments used specify climatology elements retrieve parse. data arguments default FALSE. arguments selecting climatology elements importing : pre Logical. Read precipitation (millimetres/month) server return data? pre_cv Logical. Read cv precipitation (percent) server return data? rd0 Logical. Read wet-days (number days >0.1 millimetres rain per month) return data? dtr Logical. Read mean diurnal temperature range (degrees Celsius) return data? tmp Logical. Read temperature (degrees Celsius) return data? tmn Logical. Calculate minimum temperature values (degrees Celsius) return data? tmx Logical. Calculate maximum temperature (degrees Celsius) return data? reh Logical. Read relative humidity return data? sunp Logical. Read sunshine, percent maximum possible (percent day length) return data? frs Logical. Read ground-frost records (number days ground-frost per month) return data? wnd Logical. Read 10m wind speed (metres/second) return data? elv Logical. Read elevation (convert metres kilometres) return data? x String. Local file path CRU CL v. 2.0 .dat.gz files located.

what: CRU CL v. 2.0 reference and abstract
title: getCRUCLdata
text: Mark New (1,*), David Lister (2), Mike Hulme (3), Ian Makin (4) high-resolution data set surface climate global land areas Climate Research, 2000, Vol 21, pg 1-25 (1) School Geography Environment, University Oxford, Mansfield Road, Oxford OX1 3TB, United Kingdom (2) Climatic Research Unit, (3) Tyndall Centre Climate Change Research, School Environmental Sciences, University East Anglia, Norwich NR4 7TJ, United Kingdom (4) International Water Management Institute, PO Box 2075, Colombo, Sri Lanka ABSTRACT: describe construction 10-minute latitude/longitude data set mean monthly surface climate global land areas, excluding Antarctica. climatology includes 8 climate elements - precipitation, wet-day frequency, temperature, diurnal temperature range, relative humidity, sunshine duration, ground frost frequency windspeed - interpolated data set station means period centred 1961 1990. Precipitation first defined terms parameters Gamma distribution, enabling calculation monthly precipitation given return period. data compared earlier data set 0.5 degrees latitude/longitude resolution show added value regions. data many applications applied climatology, biogeochemical modelling, hydrology agricultural meteorology available School Geography Oxford (https://www.geog.ox.ac.uk), International Water Management Institute “World Water Climate Atlas” (https://www.iwmi.org/) Climatic Research Unit (https://www.uea.ac.uk/groups--centres/climatic-research-unit).

Defaults FALSE. frs Read ground-frost records (number days ground- frost per month) return , TRUE. Defaults FALSE. wnd Read 10 m wind speed (metres/second) return , TRUE. Defaults FALSE. elv Read elevation (converted metres) return , TRUE.
